Header: Asperdiella hartii Sinhala-Korapothu krumiin; Tamil - Inchi kilangu sethil poochi

Prevention: Treat rhizome pieces before planting (refer yellow direct control)
Avoid continuous planting in the same field more than two times and follow crop rotation with leguminous crop
Deep plough and solarize before planting
Use recommended fertilizer to increase the plant vigour
Monitoring: Look for isolated patches of yellowed plants in the field
Look for sudden yellowing of leaves and the yellowing remains for long period
Examine rhizomes for brown colour scales (about 1mm) by hand lens
Direct Control: Uproot the damaged plants and burn
Rate of dilution- 2.5 g /10 lit. of water
Restrictions: Always wear personal protective equipment while handling pesticides.
Read manufacturer’s instructions carefully before handling pesticides.
Do not eat, drink or smoke while handling and applying pesticides.
Dip 10kg of rhizomes for 30 minutes and shade dry.
For rhizome treatment - Dip 10kg of rhizomes for 30 minutes and shade dry.
Toxic to predatory mites, flower bugs, parasitoids, lady bird beetles and moderately toxic to lacewings and highly toxic to bees
